collection.title: Mercedes-Benz E Class Saloon 1995 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz E Class Saloon 1995 to 2002 (W210) model requires a 25" wiper blade and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
